races.name: Visit attheraces.com EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Etonnante
runners_data.spotlight: This second foal of a Listed-placed 1m AW winner is a half-sister to French Group-placed 1m AW winner Eponine (including 2yo; RPR 101); the outside stall isn't ideal for a newcomer but she makes obvious paper appeal for her very powerful yard.

runners_data.name: Aura Of Melania
runners_data.comment: From an in-form yard but not one known for first-time-out 2yo success
runners_data.spotlight: Cost 12,000gns at the breeze-ups and is out of a mare who was runner-up from 1m-1m4f (including 2yo; RPR 78); the Roger Fell stable is going well but isn't a regular source of first-time-out 2yo success.

runners_data.name: Sovereign Beach
runners_data.comment: 62,000gns breeze-up purchase from a yard no stranger to first-time-out success
runners_data.spotlight: 62,000gns breeze-up buy who is a half-sister to four winners, notably So Majestic (Listed-placed 5f; RPR 97); stable has yet to hit the target with 2yos in 2026 but has enjoyed plenty of first-time-out juvenile success in recent years; would very much enter the reckoning if the betting vibes are strong.

runners_data.name: Lady Branksome
runners_data.comment: Trapped wide and faded into fifth on last week's AW debut; likely improver; well drawn too
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off favourite for last week's 6f Kempton debut but was trapped wider than ideal from an outside draw and faded inside the final furlong; has the rail draw this time; likely improver.

runners_data.name: Fern Clyde
runners_data.spotlight: Stepped up on her debut when just under 2l fourth of eight over C&D (good) 12 days ago; that form is below the level it usually requires to win a race like this so she'll almost certainly need to improve again.

runners_data.name: Bladey Lady
runners_data.spotlight: Minzaal half-sister to six winners but didn't achieve much when beaten just under 8l into third on her 5f Beverley debut (good to firm) 16 days ago; may do better but Fern Clyde is the more obvious of the Tim Easterby pair.

runners_data.name: Suzie May
runners_data.spotlight: Poor form in two outings at Beverley, finishing behind the reopposing Bladey Lady when a remote fourth latterly.

races.name: Book Now At ripon-races.co.uk Handicap

runners_data.name: Harswell River
runners_data.note: Natural leader with useful course form but exposed after 19 starts, low draw aids front-running tactics
runners_data.comment: 1-19 but in good form this spring and has a handy inside draw here; player
runners_data.spotlight: Exposed, having raced 19 times, but has placed three times at up to 1m at Redcar (good/good to firm) this spring; handily drawn for one who tends to race close to the pace; should go well for in-form Roger Fell.

runners_data.name: Vega's Virtue
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needing the step up to 1m for first time, Easterby stable in moderate form
runners_data.comment: Needs a step up in trip and first-time cheekpieces to spark improvement
runners_data.spotlight: No significant impact in handicaps over 7f at Doncaster and 6f here this spring; still fairly early days but needs a combination of a step up in trip and first-time cheekpieces to make a difference.

runners_data.name: Wondrous
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 238-day break, potential improver over longer trip but fading tendency concerning
runners_data.comment: Well held in three 6f runs last year but potential improvement in handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Beat only a couple home in three qualifying runs over 6f last year but rates a potential improver now handicapping over a longer trip on her return; market support would look significant.

runners_data.name: That's Enough
runners_data.note: Unknown style having only raced on AW, fading tendency and turf debut add complications
runners_data.comment: Raced on AW, finishing well held on handicap debut latest; improvement needed
runners_data.spotlight: Raced on AW; 66-1 when well held on 7f Kempton handicap debut four weeks ago; still early days but a switch to turf needs to spark improvement.

runners_data.name: Crystal Aurora
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 131-day absence, needs revival after poor winter AW form
runners_data.comment: Third on turf handicap debut last autumn but well beaten on AW over winter; off 131 days
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; third on 6f Pontefract handicap debut (soft) last autumn but well held in two AW outings over the winter; revival needed after a break.

runners_data.name: Hood Wink
runners_data.note: Strong finisher who dead-heated at Wetherby but failed to back up form twice since including C&D
runners_data.comment: Dead-heated at Wetherby in April but below par twice since, including C&D
runners_data.spotlight: Dead-heated at Wetherby (1m, good to firm) in April but has failed to back that up twice since (including C&D).

runners_data.name: Contemplation
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse winless in 7 starts, shown no threat in three runs for new trainer
runners_data.comment: Hasn't threatened in three runs for new yard, taking record to 0-7
runners_data.spotlight: 0-4 for James Ferguson and hasn't threatened in three runs for new yard.

runners_data.name: Captain Bruce
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with concerning fading pattern, tailed off in all three starts this term
runners_data.comment: Two AW wins last year but well beaten this term, including for new yard latest
runners_data.spotlight: Won 7f/1m2f AW handicaps for Nigel Tinkler last year but has finished tailed off on all three starts this term, including back on turf for new yard 16 days ago.

runners_data.name: Eva The Deeva
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making handicap debut, Tinkler stable hitting form but modest recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Makes handicap debut with her yard in form; improvement wouldn't surprise
runners_data.spotlight: Never dangerous in three outings over 6f/7f this spring but stands a much more realistic chance now handicapping and the Nigel Tinkler team has really hit form; improvement would come as no surprise.

runners_data.name: Regal Knight
runners_data.note: Front-runner who hung badly over 1m2f last time, needs trip reduction to spark improvement
runners_data.comment: Held in two 1m2f handicaps this year and return to 1m needs to spark improvement
runners_data.spotlight: No significant impact in a pair of 1m2f handicaps this year, hanging under pressure at Beverley last time; a drop back in trip needs to help him find more.

races.paceDynamic: Harswell River and Regal Knight will set a genuine pace from the start, with both having strong leading tendencies and no other confirmed pace-pressers in the field. The early tempo should be honest but not frantic given it's just two protagonists, creating a steady rhythm through the middle sections. Most of the field comprises hold-up horses who will track this pace from midfield and rear positions, setting up a sustained drive from the 3f pole. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and strong finishers, as the modest early pace will leave plenty in reserve for those who can position handy or deliver late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Two Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace between Harswell River and Regal Knight proves too taxing over this trip
scenarios.body: Both leaders will weaken markedly in the final 2f, opening the door for the strongest late-running handicappers to sweep past. Hold-up horses with proven stamina over 1m+ like Hood Wink and Crystal Aurora become the primary beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Harswell River Wins Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Harswell River can dictate fractions and see off Regal Knight's challenge
scenarios.body: His recent course form and low draw will prove decisive as he controls the race from the front throughout. The honest gallop suits his exposed but consistent profile, while others struggle to peg him back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Suits
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders maintain a strong tempo that stretches the field
scenarios.body: The honest pace will expose stamina limitations in several runners while suiting those with proven 1m credentials. Prominent racers who can track the pace without overexerting become perfectly positioned for late challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Regal Knight Bounces Back
scenarios.trigger: If the trip reduction to 1m significantly aids Regal Knight's effectiveness
scenarios.body: His recent hanging under pressure over longer trips disappears, allowing him to use his natural pace more efficiently. The drop back in distance transforms his recent disappointing efforts into a more potent challenge.

watchPoints.text: Harswell River could steal this if allowed uncontested lead given his consistent course form and tactical advantage from stall 1
Vega's Virtue making handicap debut over new trip - market support would indicate significant improvement expected
Wondrous returning from long break with step up in trip could spring surprise if fitness holds, watch for market confidence
Hood Wink's recent course failure despite previous 1m success suggests either track doesn't suit or form declining
Both Captain Bruce and That's Enough switching surfaces having only raced on AW recently, adaptation required

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap

runners_data.name: North West Gal

runners_data.comment: Made encouraging seasonal/handicap debut this month; player if coming on for the run

runners_data.name: Valor Spirit

runners_data.name: Country Artiste
runners_data.note: Only confirmed leader but 0-9 overall and 128 days since last run raises fitness concerns
runners_data.comment: Soundly beaten on both AW starts for new stable in January; returns from four-month break
runners_data.spotlight: Started off for Craig Lidster with two very underwhelming AW runs in January (6f/5f) and is now 0-9 overall; difficult to enthuse over on first start for four months.

runners_data.name: Simba's Pride
runners_data.note: In-form prominent runner who won last start at Hamilton then ran close second over course and distance
runners_data.comment: Has gone close over C&D since this month's winning handicap debut at Hamilton; big player
runners_data.spotlight: Suited by drop back in trip when scoring on this month's handicap debut at Hamilton (6f, good) and probably bettered that performance when close second over C&D (good) a fortnight later; back in action before 1lb nudge takes effect and nicely drawn towards nearside rail; big player.

runners_data.name: Uncertainty
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who's been disappointing for new trainer Simon Whitaker in both recent starts
runners_data.comment: Well beaten on both starts for current stable; others have much less to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Second in 7f AW nursery on final run for Richard Hannon but well beaten on both starts for new stable, latterly in 6f Doncaster handicap on seasonal reappearance 12 days ago; others have much less to prove.

runners_data.name: Head For Freedom
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who ran encouraging fourth over course and distance on seasonal return
runners_data.comment: Encouraging fourth over C&D on seasonal debut and had some excuses last time
runners_data.spotlight: Made encouraging seasonal debut when fourth of 13 over C&D (good to soft) last month and had some excuses when below that form over 5f at Beverley 24 days ago (suffered interference in first half of race); on a good mark now and enters calculations.

runners_data.name: Come On Over
runners_data.note: Prominent eight-race maiden who encountered traffic problems, needs to find significant improvement

runners_data.name: Northern Tempest

runners_data.comment: Soundly beaten after racing too freely in two AW handicaps this spring; now 0-5 overall
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten after racing too freely in two AW handicaps (6f/7f) this spring and has now been unplaced all five starts; stable has a much more obvious chance with Simba's Pride.

runners_data.name: Great Success
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who raced too freely on seasonal debut and faces wide draw disadvantage
runners_data.comment: Still unexposed but was beaten 19l after racing too freely on seasonal/handicap debut (7f)
runners_data.spotlight: Still unexposed after only four runs but was beaten about 19l after racing too freely on last month's seasonal/handicap debut (7f) and is drawn on the wing for this sprint return.

runners_data.name: Solar Cooper
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who bounced back to form with course and distance win 11 days ago in first-time cheekpieces

runners_data.spotlight: Started off for new stable with two down-the-field runs last month but bounced back to form with clear C&D (good) win in first-time cheekpices 11 days ago; not ideally drawn today and goes without cheekpieces this time but still respected under 6lb penalty (due to go up that amount anyway).

races.paceDynamic: Country Artiste will take this field along as the sole confirmed leader, setting what should be a manageable pace without early pressure. The prominent runners Black Missile, North West Gal, Simba's Pride, and Come On Over will track closely behind, while the hold-up horses Valor Spirit, Uncertainty, Head For Freedom, Great Success, and Solar Cooper will need to find gaps in the straight. With only one natural leader and several hold-up types, the pace is likely to be steady early before quickening significantly in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position themselves handily and kick from the turn rather than those coming from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Kick Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners Black Missile, North West Gal, or Simba's Pride track Country Artiste perfectly through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: They'll have ideal positioning to strike turning for home when the hold-up horses are still fighting for racing room. The steady early pace followed by acceleration suits horses with tactical speed positioned in the first four.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If Country Artiste sets genuine pace and the prominent group goes too hard chasing
scenarios.body: Solar Cooper and Valor Spirit can exploit tired leaders with their finishing kicks despite wide draws. The strong pace collapse favours stamina and class from the back markers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wire-to-Wire Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Country Artiste gets uncontested lead with all prominent runners sitting too far back
scenarios.body: He can dictate comfortable splits and kick clear when the chasers finally engage, holding on through superior positioning. The lack of early pace pressure allows the front-runner to control completely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Northern Tempest races keenly again and drags the pace to unsustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The entire field comes back to the closers who benefit from the strong gallop and superior class ratings. Multiple hold-up horses converge in a blanket finish favouring the highest-rated.

watchPoints.text: Northern Tempest racing keenly early could drag the pace to unsustainable fractions and ruin prominent chances
Country Artiste's 128-day absence may show as the field quickens, potentially leaving the door open for closers
Solar Cooper's first-time cheekpieces worked perfectly last time and bears watching for back-to-back wins
Great Success and Uncertainty both drawn wide in stalls 10+ face significant tactical disadvantage over this sharp 6f trip
Simba's Pride dropping back to 6f after recent course and distance second suggests trainer has found optimal conditions

runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who has been a good second at Lingfield (7f, AW) and Redcar (1m, good) this spring; hasn't necessarily shaped as if crying out for this trip but he's likely to be bang there again if his stamina holds.

runners_data.name: Parole d'Oro

runners_data.name: James McHenry

runners_data.name: Prince Of The Seas

runners_data.name: Spioradalta
runners_data.note: Course winner last month but prominent style puts him right in the traffic danger zone approaching home turn

runners_data.name: Austrian Theory

runners_data.name: Financer
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who can benefit from the pace setup though the York Dante meeting blow-out raises slight fitness doubts
runners_data.comment: Has some decent C&D form and should find this easier than the York Dante meeting last time

runners_data.name: Spirit Of Acklam
runners_data.comment: Off for a year but C&D win on 2024 reappearance shows he's capable when fresh
runners_data.spotlight: Scored with a fair degree of authority at Ayr (1m2f, good; from 2lb lower) in April 2025; absent since toiling at Chester 362 days ago, which raises concerns, but he did win over C&D on his 2024 reappearance; the betting should help to guide expectations.

races.paceDynamic: Garden Oasis will lead unchallenged early with Londoner, James McHenry, Prince Of The Seas and Spioradalta all wanting prominent positions behind him. The congestion 2-3 furlongs out will be severe as four horses jostle for tracking positions, creating interference and forcing wide moves. Garden Oasis can dictate a steady gallop that suits his stamina reserves, while the prominent brigade will compromise each other's chances through traffic problems. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging and deliver late runs down the outside.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses capitalise
scenarios.trigger: If Garden Oasis sets steady fractions and the prominent quartet get tangled up approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: The pace-setters create perfect conditions for closers while the prominent runners check each other's momentum in heavy traffic. El Matador and Parole d'Oro can sweep past the battling leaders with clear runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Garden Oasis wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If Garden Oasis gets easy early fractions and kicks clear before the prominent pack can organise
scenarios.body: His 11yo experience and front-running expertise allows him to steal a decisive break while the quality horses behind are still sorting themselves out. The weight advantage and course familiarity prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent battle decides
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong from the start and Garden Oasis weakens in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Londoner and James McHenry settle the race between them after tracking the pace in good positions, with their superior class telling late. The hold-up horses find too much to do from off the strong gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Garden Oasis goes very slowly early and no other pace pressure emerges
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the most talented horse wins regardless of position, favouring the highest-rated runners. Parole d'Oro's class advantage becomes the deciding factor in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch for severe interference 2-3 furlongs out when Londoner, James McHenry, Prince Of The Seas and Spioradalta converge behind Garden Oasis
Monitor Garden Oasis early fractions as he has the race at his mercy if allowed to dictate a steady tempo unchallenged
Check El Matador's position turning for home as he needs to be within striking distance to use his finishing kick effectively
Prince Of The Seas with inexperienced 5lb claimer Jack Dace could cause traffic problems when the pace intensifies
Spirit Of The Acklam returning after 362 days makes any market support significant given the lengthy absence

races.paceDynamic: Tarlac will make the running from stall position with Hurstwood, Barmyblade and Angel Of England looking to track closely in the prominent positions. The lack of multiple confirmed front-runners means Tarlac can dictate a manageable tempo without early pressure, likely setting steady fractions that will suit those racing handy. This creates a tactical advantage for prominent racers and strong-finishing hold-up horses who can time their challenge, while making life difficult for those needing to improve position from midfield. The race shape strongly favours prominent trackers and late closer types who can benefit from the solid pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tarlac Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Tarlac gets an uncontested lead and sets modest fractions in the first half
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows him to kick clear turning for home while prominent trackers like Hurstwood get first run at him. Hold-up horses struggle to close the gap from too far back against the controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Development
scenarios.trigger: If Hurstwood and Barmyblade press Tarlac early creating honest gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace sets up perfectly for late closers with Jet Warrior and Night Emperor getting ideal conditions to unleash finishing kicks. Prominent horses find the strong pace taking its toll in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Rank Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast trying to break each other in the first 3f
scenarios.body: Tarlac, Hurstwood and Barmyblade all weaken dramatically allowing hold-up horses to sweep past them. The pace collapse particularly suits Tickets and Solar Biricz coming from the rear with fresh legs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to make the running early creating a crawling pace throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine tempo turns the race into a sprint from the 2f pole heavily favouring those with the best turn of foot. Prominent racers with tactical speed like Barmyblade can capitalize on the positioning advantage.

watchPoints.text: Angel Of England and Ridgemaster both show clear evidence of fading badly in the finish making them tactical liabilities
Tarlac applying first-time headgear after disappointing effort but Kyle McHugh's 7lb claim may not suit front-running tactics
Barmyblade arrives in poor current form despite excellent course record and strong Tim Easterby 14-day statistics
Jet Warrior carrying 5lb penalty but still appears well-handicapped after impressive Ayr victory under same jockey
Hurstwood's historical course dominance in this race makes him dangerous despite moderate recent efforts

races.name: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Handicap

runners_data.name: Spartan Times
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from 217-day break with only a hurdles run for fitness, vulnerable to race-fit rivals despite course form
runners_data.comment: Four Flat wins in 2025, including here; won over hurdles this month and fair fourth since
runners_data.spotlight: Notched four Flat wins last year, including over 1m3f here on good; returned from a break to win over hurdles at Uttoxeter (2m, good) this month; only a fair fourth at Aintree since but still respected back on the Flat.

runners_data.name: Sir Edward Lear
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who may have needed his recent reappearance and could improve significantly for that outing
runners_data.comment: Might have needed recent return; back on winning mark so good claims if returning to best
runners_data.spotlight: This course scorer might have needed his recent reappearance and is well treated if bouncing back to his best, having returned to the mark he defied at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm) last August; also went close over C&D last summer; cheekpieces off, visor back on; yard hasn't been as prolific as usual in the last couple of weeks but that's likely to change before long.

runners_data.name: Polygram
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who changed stables and remains a maiden after 12 starts, needs strong pace to be competitive
runners_data.comment: Not disgraced at Hamilton latest but never threatened and now 0-12; can start slowly
runners_data.spotlight: Went close more than once for Harry Charlton but left that yard an eight-race maiden; hasn't threatened to put that right in four runs for new stable but went with a bit more promise when sixth of 11 over 1m3f at Hamilton 11 days ago, keeping on from off the pace after missing the break again; due to be 2lb lower from the weekend.

runners_data.name: Something
runners_data.note: Made all in this race last year but has been disappointing since stable switch, retains course-winning tactics
runners_data.comment: Won this race last year; respectable third last month; should have a say for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Made all in this race off 2lb higher on good to soft for Jedd O'Keeffe last year; drew a blank in six outings for Stuart Williams but latest 1m4f Doncaster third on good to firm was respectable; sold for 8,000gns since; could make another bold bid in this race.

runners_data.name: So Alex
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 159-day layoff after Tapeta wins, significant fitness question on turf return
runners_data.comment: Well held on AW before Christmas but progressed well prior to that and retains potential
runners_data.spotlight: Progressed in his first three handicaps, winning over 1m4f on Wolverhampton's Tapeta in November/December; something can't have been right when well held there just before Christmas; absent subsequently and makes first turf start since his debut; remains with potential.

races.paceDynamic: Spartan Times and Something are confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead, creating an honest gallop from the start. Sir Edward Lear and So Alex will sit prominent just behind this battle, while Polygram as the sole hold-up horse will track from the rear. With two keen leaders likely to engage early over this stamina-testing 1m4f trip, the pace will be solid throughout. This sustained gallop strongly favours prominent runners who can position close enough to strike but avoid the early speed duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dual pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Spartan Times and Something both commit fully to the early lead battle over 1m4f
scenarios.body: The two front-runners will weaken from their speed duel, allowing the prominent runners to inherit the race in the final two furlongs. Sir Edward Lear and So Alex benefit from tracking the pace without expending energy in the early contest.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of Spartan Times or Something establishes an uncontested lead while the other settles
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time in front and has enough left to resist late challenges over this stamina test. The honest gallop suits horses with proven tactical speed who can make all or lead from early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong with multiple horses committed forward
scenarios.body: Polygram benefits from a truly-run race where the early pace collapses dramatically in the final quarter-mile. His hold-up style allows him to pick up the pieces when others have shot their bolt.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace fragmented
scenarios.trigger: If the two main pace-setters fail to engage properly creating a falsely-run race
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns this into a sprint finish where the strongest horse on the day wins regardless of tactics. This scenario removes the tactical advantage and makes form the primary factor.

watchPoints.text: Spartan Times may not have the fitness to sustain his front-running style after such a long break from flat racing
Something's tendency to make all could be compromised if Spartan Times forces a genuine early battle
Sir Edward Lear showed signs of needing his comeback run and could improve markedly for the fitness
So Alex faces a significant step up in class returning to turf after his all-weather success
Polygram needs the two front-runners to go fast early or his hold-up style becomes irrelevant in a small field

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap

runners_data.name: South Parade
runners_data.note: Lone early leader but poor recent form suggests she may weaken when challenged despite tactical advantage
runners_data.spotlight: On a dangerous mark but she doesn't look in much form, finishing down the field again at Thirsk (Tees Aggregates several places ahead of her) 12 days ago; needs to rediscover her spark.

runners_data.name: Our Absent Friends
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 60-day break which raises fitness concerns despite previous course success
runners_data.comment: Good second at Newcastle in March but well held at Doncaster later in month; off since
runners_data.spotlight: Seven wins, the latest at Newcastle in December off a 6lb lower mark; good second off 1lb lower back at Newcastle in March but well held back on turf at Doncaster later that month; freshened up since.

runners_data.name: Tees Aggregates
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with solid recent form who benefits when getting clear runs in sprint finishes
runners_data.comment: Recent efforts respectable and has a good 0-70 record; enters calculations
runners_data.spotlight: Doesn't always look the easiest of rides but recent efforts respectable (fifth of 17 at Thirsk latest) and he's been successful on the last two occasions he's dropped into a 0-70; considered.

runners_data.name: Dc Cogent
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up horse seeking first handicap win but has been placing regularly suggesting ability is there
runners_data.comment: 0-14 in handicaps but in decent form this spring and easy to ignore latest run (hampered)
runners_data.spotlight: AW maiden winner; 0-14 in handicaps but is in a consistent vein of form, reaching the frame three times this spring, including third to Herakles at Nottingham (5f, good); met trouble when a beaten favourite at Carlisle last week and can have that effort ignored.

runners_data.name: Herakles
runners_data.note: Recent course winner from hold-up style with Dc Cogent and Marajito behind, giving him strong form edge
runners_data.comment: Winning return to turf at Nottingham this month but has yet to score back-to-back
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner; consistent in defeat on AW before making a successful return to turf at Nottingham (5f, good) 19 days ago, with reopposing Dc Cogent and Marajito behind in third and fifth; did that quite comfortably but a 6lb rise puts him 3lb above his highest win mark of 66; has also yet to score back-to-back in his 41-race career.

runners_data.name: Canaria Queen
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carrying 5lb penalty after recent Musselburgh win but still well-handicapped for Tim Easterby
runners_data.comment: Has won two of last three and a 5lb penalty shouldn't prevent another bold bid
runners_data.spotlight: Made it two wins in last three starts when seeing off seven rivals at Musselburgh (5f, good) last Thursday; a 5lb penalty shouldn't prevent another bold bid in her current mood.

runners_data.name: Marajito
runners_data.note: Prominent runner showing improved form when fifth to Herakles last time, suggesting return to winning ways
runners_data.comment: Ran well for a long way behind two of these on Nottingham reappearance; on good mark
runners_data.spotlight: Made all in maiden handicap at Redcar (5f, good to firm) last June; disappointing after that in 2025 but more encouraging signs when fifth of nine to Herakles (Dc Cogent third) on Nottingham reappearance 19 days ago, fading late as if the outing was just needed; enters calculations having dipped 2lb below her winning mark.

runners_data.name: Wrestling Revenue
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer on attractive low weight but hasn't reproduced last year's Pontefract winning form
runners_data.comment: Below par of late but back on last winning mark and worth a look in the betting
runners_data.spotlight: Well backed when winning a 5f handicap at Pontefract (soft) last October but hasn't matched that since, including beating only one home over C&D three weeks ago; back on the mark he defied at Pontefract but would need to see money for him again.

races.paceDynamic: South Parade will lead from the gates with Our Absent Friends, Canaria Queen and Marajito tracking in prominent positions, creating a modest early gallop over this minimum trip. The pace should be genuine but not destructive given the sprint distance and good ground conditions. With five runners adopting hold-up tactics including in-form Herakles and consistent Tees Aggregates, the strong contingent of closers will benefit from the sustained pace and should dominate the finish. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest and the closers get clear runs
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop plays perfectly into the hands of the back markers who can unleash superior finishing speed. Herakles, Tees Aggregates and Dc Cogent all thrive when able to close late over this trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Hold On
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong early and the closers fail to quicken
scenarios.body: Canaria Queen's recent winning form and Marajito's front-running ability allow them to resist the late challenge. The early positions prove crucial when the finish becomes tactical rather than a pure speed contest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: South Parade Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If South Parade gets an uncontested lead and stays strong
scenarios.body: The lone leader dictates ideal fractions and kicks clear when the prominent runners come under pressure. Her tactical advantage from the front outweighs recent poor form when allowed to control the race completely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling and it turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test where raw ability trumps positioning and any horse can win from any part of the field. Form lines become less reliable when tactical advantage is neutralized by the lack of early tempo.

watchPoints.text: South Parade could get an uncontested lead if the other prominent runners fail to go forward early enough
Tees Aggregates and Wrestling Revenue need clear runs in the final furlong given their hold-up styles and the sprint finish
Canaria Queen's 5lb penalty could prove decisive if the race becomes tight between her and Herakles
Our Absent Friends' 60-day absence may show as the pace quickens despite his prominent running style suiting the track
Herakles has strong form edge over Dc Cogent and Marajito from their Nottingham meeting 19 days ago
